{{Top|leg|canon=Knuckle duster}}
'''Brass knuckles''' were a type of personal hand-held [[Melee/Legends|melee]] weapon. The imposing [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Brooser]], who frequently engaged in brawling, often carried brass knuckles on his person.
